info.name: Lists connectors in the specified compartment.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment for this request.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description:
A filter to return only resources that match the given lifecycle state.

Example: `ACTIVE`

params.name: displayName
params.description:
A filter to return only resources that match the given display name exactly.

Example: `example_service_connector`

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return
in a paginated "List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous
"List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for `timeCreated` is descending.
Default order for `displayName` is ascending. If no value is specified `timeCreated` is default.

items.docs:
Lists connectors in the specified compartment.
For more information, see
[Listing Connectors](/iaas/Content/connector-hub/list-service-connector.htm).

Creates a new connector in the specified compartment.
A connector is a logically defined flow for moving data from
a source service to a destination service in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
For more information, see
[Creating a Connector](/iaas/Content/connector-hub/create-service-connector.htm).
For general information about connectors, see
[Overview of Connector Hub](/iaas/Content/connector-hub/overview.htm).

items.docs:

For more information, see

info.name: Updates the configuration information for the specified connector.

params.name: serviceConnectorId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the connector.

items.docs:
Updates the configuration information for the specified connector.
For more information, see
[Updating a Connector](/iaas/Content/connector-hub/update-service-connector.htm).

After you send your request, the connector's state is temporarily
UPDATING and any data transfer pauses. The state then changes back to its
original value: if ACTIVE, then data transfer resumes.

params.name: serviceConnectorId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the connector.

items.docs:
Deletes the specified connector.
For more information, see
[Deleting a Connector](/iaas/Content/connector-hub/delete-service-connector.htm).

After you send your request, the connector's state is temporarily
DELETING and any data transfer stops. The state then changes to DELETED.

info.name: Activate the ServiceConnector identified by the id

params.name: serviceConnectorId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the connector.

items.docs:
Activates the specified connector.

After you send your request, the connector's state is temporarily
UPDATING. When the state changes to ACTIVE, data begins transferring from the
source service to the target service.
For more information, see
[Activating a Connector](/iaas/Content/connector-hub/activate-service-connector.htm).

info.name: Moves a connector into a different compartment within the same tenancy.

params.name: serviceConnectorId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the connector.

items.docs:
Moves a connector into a different compartment within the same tenancy.
For more information, see
[Moving a Connector](/iaas/Content/connector-hub/change-compartment-service-connector.htm).

When provided, If-Match is checked against ETag values of the resource.

params.name: serviceConnectorId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the connector.

items.docs:
Deactivates the specified connector.

After you send your request, the connector's state is temporarily
UPDATING and any data transfer stops. The state then changes to INACTIVE.
For more information, see
[Deactivating a Connector](/iaas/Content/connector-hub/deactivate-service-connector.htm).
